en.storyText:
As our friend (or family), you probably heard a lot about our whirlwind romance so we don’t need to write a novel. We met in Sri Lanka just before Christmas 2023, and after a year, 3 continents*, traveling to 9 countries so we can spend time together, we finally settled down into a very boring and uneventful life in Sydney, Australia. 

*2 Continents, if you use the correct geographic definition
en.locationIntro: Now, we are happy to announce that we’re getting married, and would love you to join us and celebrate.
en.locationNote: Join us for one — or both
en.hungaryText:
To make things easier (or more complicated) for our international family and friends, we will organise two weddings: one in a beautiful village in the north east of Hungary, and one in Sydney. And you’re welcome to join us for one, or both.

Mad village is a hidden gem In the historic wine region of Tokaj. We hope you can not just attend the wedding, but spend at least a few days with us exploring the region, tasting wine, beautiful hikes and a traditional wine harvest.
en.sydneyText: Sydney wedding will be in a pub. Or a hill with a view.
en.tyMsg: We can't wait to celebrate with you!
en.thankYouTitle: Thank you for celebrating with us
en.thankYouText:
We are so happy you'll be joining us. We'll be in touch soon with everything you need — where to stay, how to get there, and what to expect.
